title: 2025 annual inbound visitor prefecture visit rates, top 10
survey: インバウンド消費動向調査 2025年（令和7年）暦年【確報】
table: 表6-1 国籍・地域（21区分）別 都道府県別訪問率
column: 全国籍・地域 / 訪問率
population: 一般客・全目的（観光・レジャー以外の目的を含む）
metric: Prefecture visit rate (%) / 都道府県別訪問率（複数回答）
metricNotes: Rates refer to prefectures visited during the trip, not unique people or guest-nights.
A visitor can report more than one prefecture. Rates must not be summed as a share of unique visitors.
The annual series is used rather than an incomplete 2026 quarter, to avoid seasonal ranking changes.
All-purpose visitors are included; do not label this tourism/leisure-only data.
This ranks destinations visited, not the popularity or sales of jewelry.
method: Downloaded the official .xls linked under 2025年 集計表 暦年 and read sheet 表6-1 using xlrd. Cross-checked report terminology. The official index last updated 2026-10-21 notes corrected tables published 2026-10-08. No secondary ranking used as final evidence.

readerMethod.en: Ordered by Japan Tourism Agency prefecture visit rates for 2025 (all trip purposes; multiple responses). This is a destination ranking, not a jewelry popularity ranking.
